title: 鋁合金摩擦攪拌接合
summary: 以「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「表面焊道完整卻根部未接合」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of An intact crown with an unbonded root.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜擴散尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffusion length: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」的「擴散尺度」採以下合成教學值：D=1e-10 m²/s；time=100 s。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 sqrt(2*D*time)；獨立基準為 0.000141421356 m。把 D 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 0.00014832397 m。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding, use synthetic inputs for Diffusion length: D=1e-10 m²/s；time=100 s. Check dimensions before evaluating sqrt(2*D*time); the independent benchmark is 0.000141421356 m. Increase D by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 0.00014832397 m. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: D增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 6.9026135e-06 m。這是特徵尺度，不是必然完成接合或反應的深度；D的適用溫區需另證。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 6.9026135e-06 m. This is a characteristic scale, not guaranteed bonding/reaction depth; the validity range of D needs evidence.
steps.failure: 表面焊道完整卻根部未接合；這是特徵尺度，不是必然完成接合或反應的深度；D的適用溫區需另證。
steps.failureEn: An intact crown with an unbonded root; This is a characteristic scale, not guaranteed bonding/reaction depth; the validity range of D needs evidence.
steps.check: 原值重算與 0.000141421356 m 相符；10%案例與 0.00014832397 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 0.000141421356 m at baseline and 0.00014832397 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

steps.title: 單元1｜擴散尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Diffusion length: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」設計「擴散尺度」的獨立驗證：在兩個時間點比較剖面寬度，檢查是否符合平方根尺度而非直線。 使用數位接合截面和惰性試片紀錄，分開名義面積、有效接合面積與失效位置。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding, independently verify Diffusion length: Compare profile widths at two times and test square-root rather than linear scaling. Use digital joint sections and inert coupon records to separate nominal area, bonded area and failure location. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「表面焊道完整卻根部未接合」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate An intact crown with an unbonded root rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 表面焊道完整卻根部未接合；這是特徵尺度，不是必然完成接合或反應的深度；D的適用溫區需另證。
steps.failureEn: An intact crown with an unbonded root; This is a characteristic scale, not guaranteed bonding/reaction depth; the validity range of D needs evidence.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「這是特徵尺度，不是必然完成接合或反應的深度；D的適用溫區需另證。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is a characteristic scale, not guaranteed bonding/reaction depth; the validity range of D needs evidence.

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」的「顯熱需求」採以下合成教學值：mass=2 kg；cp=500 J/(kg K)；delta=10 K。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 mass*cp*delta/1000；獨立基準為 10 kJ。把 mass 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 11 kJ。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding, use synthetic inputs for Sensible heat: mass=2 kg；cp=500 J/(kg K)；delta=10 K. Check dimensions before evaluating mass*cp*delta/1000; the independent benchmark is 10 kJ. Increase mass by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 11 kJ. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: mass增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 1 kJ。假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 1 kJ. Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.failure: 表面焊道完整卻根部未接合；假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.failureEn: An intact crown with an unbonded root; Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.check: 原值重算與 10 kJ 相符；10%案例與 11 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 10 kJ at baseline and 11 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（kJ）？
quiz.explanation: 按 mass*cp*delta/1000 逐項代入，結果為 10；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into mass*cp*delta/1000 gives 10; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 原理與模型
knowledge.text: 顯熱由質量、比熱與溫差相乘；功率與能量需另用時間換算。
knowledge.textEn: Sensible heat is mass times heat capacity times temperature difference; use time to distinguish power and energy.

knowledge.title: 案例與驗證界限
knowledge.text: 摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷。假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。 前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
knowledge.textEn: Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding. Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.

steps.title: 單元2｜顯熱需求：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Sensible heat: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」設計「顯熱需求」的獨立驗證：記錄質量、起終溫度、溫度探頭位置及空白容器熱容量。 使用數位接合截面和惰性試片紀錄，分開名義面積、有效接合面積與失效位置。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding, independently verify Sensible heat: Record mass, initial/final temperature, probe positions and empty-container heat capacity. Use digital joint sections and inert coupon records to separate nominal area, bonded area and failure location. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「表面焊道完整卻根部未接合」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate An intact crown with an unbonded root rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 表面焊道完整卻根部未接合；假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.failureEn: An intact crown with an unbonded root; Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：記錄質量、起終溫度、溫度探頭位置及空白容器熱容量。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Record mass, initial/final temperature, probe positions and empty-container heat capacity.

steps.title: 單元2｜顯熱需求：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Sensible heat: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「表面焊道完整卻根部未接合」。以本單元「顯熱需求」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「記錄質量、起終溫度、溫度探頭位置及空白容器熱容量。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is An intact crown with an unbonded root. For Sensible heat, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Record mass, initial/final temperature, probe positions and empty-container heat capacity. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「表面焊道完整卻根部未接合」不是單靠 10 kJ 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 10 kJ alone cannot exclude An intact crown with an unbonded root; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 表面焊道完整卻根部未接合；假設比熱固定且無相變；有蒸發、熔化或反應熱時須另列項。
steps.failureEn: An intact crown with an unbonded root; Assumes constant heat capacity and no phase change; evaporation, melting and reaction require separate terms.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「摩擦攪拌焊的材料流線與根部缺陷」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Material flow and root flaws in friction-stir welding and retaining failed cases.
